script_text: This week, Neptune's influence on your 12th House will reveal hidden truths. Mercury in retrograde aspects your 7th House of partnerships on Monday and Wednesday, creating miscommunications and emotional turbulence in love. Tuesday brings tension as Saturn squares your 10th House, so avoid signing contracts or making career moves. Thursday marks a powerful turning point as Jupiter trines your 2nd House of finance and income, shifting luck toward money and stability. The weekend brings clarity as the Sun sextiles your 5th House of romance, making Saturday ideal for heartfelt conversations and new connections. Friday is your power day because Jupiter strengthens your financial sector, amplifying prosperity. Sunday is challenging due to Neptune's haze clouding your 12th House, so avoid major decisions. Focus on open dialogue and trust your intuition this week. Follow for daily updates.
